5. Executive Decision Memo

EXECUTIVE DECISION: LAUNCH VARIANT B TO 100% PRODUCTION

Primary Finding: Variant B (Single-Page Accordion Checkout with Express Pay and Guest Checkout) decisively outperformed Control A, elevating checkout conversion from 12.35% to 14.22%, an absolute gain of +1.87% points and a relative conversion lift of +15.13% (p = 1.87e-06).

Business & Financial Impact: On an annual volume of 1.2M checkout attempts and an average order value of ~$84.65, this conversion lift generates +22,421 additional completed orders and +$1.90M in incremental top-line annual revenue.

Risk & Guardrail Assessment:

  • No Basket Size Erosion: Average Order Value held steady ($84.47 vs $84.65, p = 0.879).
  • Friction Reduced: Checkout completion time decreased by 55.9 seconds (-30.8%).
  • Sample Integrity: No Sample Ratio Mismatch observed (SRM p = 0.9908).

Rollout Roadmap: Deploy to 100% of web traffic via 3-stage ramp (50% → 75% → 100% over 48 hours). Monitor payment provider webhooks for elevated authorization failure rates.
